name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: A library of 177 ready-made 'cheat sheets' that teach an AI agent exactly how to use specialized science software and databases correctly, across biology, chemistry, and drug discovery.
buyer: A small biotech founder or academic lab PI who can't afford a dedicated bioinformatics or cheminformatics hire and wants their AI agent to competently run specialized scientific analyses instead.
business_use_cases: A small biotech runs virtual drug screening and ADMET analysis in-house with an AI agent using these skills, instead of hiring a cheminformatics specialist.
A PhD student automates variant annotation and phylogenetics for their thesis using an agent that correctly calls the right scientific tools and databases.
A contract research organization offers 'AI co-scientist' analysis packages to small biotech clients, powered by this skill library plus the companion local app.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid setup-and-support service for labs that want this running but lack the technical staff to configure it themselves.
Run specific scientific analyses (e.g. ADMET screening batches) as a paid service for small labs using this skill set plus cloud compute.

steal_this: Pick one validated skill, like ADMET analysis, and offer a one-off paid analysis run to a local small biotech or academic lab this weekend.
